evidence.summary: The native application invokes the compiler-inventory-bound provider and writes typed TestResult/CheckResult artifacts without a provider subprocess.
The existing retained embed batch path already establishes same-session typed composition for the self-suite.

reproduction.instructions: Run tests/test_phase6_provider_generation.py and inspect the native provider application result; compare with the historical per-test subprocess claim.

summary: The original claim that every MNCS invocation requires a fresh subprocess plus full compile is no longer true for the native provider path: one application launch performs typed provider execution and structured publication in the same session. External CLI launch, compilation, and dynamic provider admission remain separate boundaries.

workaround.description: The external CLI and no-embed fallback still use host subprocess/JSON transport; authoritative runtime-selected provider admission is tracked separately.
